text.name: fp_help_start_1_text
text.text: Alt + Numpad 0 shows or hides the FarmPilot HUD. Middle mouse button: shows the cursor to click in the HUD. The 1st list is the destination; the lists below (unload, fill type) appear depending on the mode.

text.name: fp_help_start_2_text
text.text: Start/Stop starts or stops the driver. Mode button: left click = next mode, right click = previous mode. Continue: restarts a waiting driver. Park: sends the vehicle to its park position (right click: sets that position).

text.name: fp_help_start_3_text
text.text: Ctrl + Alt + Right / Left arrow: next / previous destination. Ctrl + Alt + Numpad 0: settings. Ctrl + Alt + M: message history. Shift + C / Shift + V: copy / paste settings from one vehicle to another. All keys can be changed in Options > Controls.

text.name: fp_help_driveto_1_text
text.text: Pick a destination, then Start. The vehicle follows the road network to the destination, then stops.

text.name: fp_help_driveto_2_text
text.text: If the HUD button « Start AI/CP at destination » is on (right click: Courseplay, AIVE or game helper), that helper takes over on arrival, with the course already loaded in the vehicle. To let FarmPilot pick the Courseplay course itself, use the Autonomous mode.

text.name: fp_help_autonomous_1_text
text.text: Like Drive: pick the field (destination) and start. On arrival, FarmPilot takes the saved Courseplay course that has exactly the width of the attached tool, loads it and starts Courseplay at the first waypoint of the course. A work tool must be attached (tillage, seeder, sprayer, spreader, mower, baler...): with only a tipper, a flatbed or a combine, the mode does not start.

text.name: fp_help_autonomous_2_text
text.text: Only courses saved in Courseplay (Courses menu, all folders) are used, on the arrival field or its field group (AutoSwitch merged fields when AutoSwitch is installed). The width is compared to 10 cm, like the Courseplay settings.

text.name: fp_help_autonomous_3_text
text.text: The course used is remembered for this field and this tool, in the savegame. The next year, with the same tool and width, it is used again directly, even if several courses would fit.

text.name: fp_help_autonomous_4_text
text.text: If no course has the right width, or several fit without a remembered choice, the driver stops and waits; a message gives the reason. Pick the course in the Autonomous courses window, then start again. Without Courseplay, depending on the setting « Autonomous without Courseplay », the driver waits or the base game worker takes the field (classic mode).

text.name: fp_help_autonomous_5_text
text.text: HUD button (in Autonomous mode, in place of the Courseplay button) or Ctrl + Alt + Numpad 5, in the vehicle with the tool attached. One line per field or field group. Change: goes to the next course, then back to Automatic. Automatic: clears the choice. Double click = Change.

text.name: fp_help_autonomous_6_text
text.text: In Autonomous mode, the 3rd HUD line is the next field (empty by default). Pick a field in the list, or right-click it on the map; right-click the line to clear it. When the current field is finished, the next field moves to the 1st line, the « Next field » line is cleared and the driver goes to work it. If it is empty, the driver goes to park as before.

text.name: fp_help_autonomous_7_title
text.text: Implement parked at its place, implement to fetch

text.name: fp_help_autonomous_7_text
text.text: End of the work without a next field: if the implement has its park position and the tractor its own, the driver drops the implement at its place, disconnects hoses and PTO (manual attach mod), detaches it, then parks the tractor. Park positions are set as usual (Ctrl + click on P in editor mode: implement selected for the implement's place, no implement selected for the tractor's). Weights are ignored; with several implements attached, it parks as before. The 2nd HUD line (« Implement ») is the implement to fetch before the field, shown by its function and width (farm implements, detached, that fit the tractor's rear hitch). At start, the driver follows your routes to the implement's place (or to the network point in front of it), reverses, attaches it, connects hoses and PTO, lifts it and drives to the field. « The attached one » (or right-click the line): nothing to fetch.

text.name: fp_help_autonomous_8_text
text.text: In Autonomous mode, the 4th HUD line is the implement for the next field (« The same » by default; right-click the line to go back to it). It is only used with a next field. When the current field is finished, the driver drops the attached implement at its park position (as at the end of the work), fetches the next implement (by your roads, reversing, attaching, hoses and PTO), then drives to the next field. The next implement then moves to the « Implement » line and the « Next implement » line goes back to « The same ». If the next implement is used by another vehicle or does not fit this tractor, the attached implement is dropped at its place anyway, then the driver stops there and a message gives the reason: restart when the next implement is free. If the attached implement has no park position or several implements are attached, nothing changes: the driver stops at the end of the field with a message.

text.name: fp_help_deliverto_1_text
text.text: Pick the unload destination, then Start. The vehicle drives there, unloads its trailer, parks if a park position is set, otherwise stops.

text.name: fp_help_pickupdeliver_1_text
text.text: 1st list: loading point; 2nd list: unloading point; 3rd list: fill type to load. The vehicle loads, delivers, then starts again.

text.name: fp_help_pickupdeliver_2_text
text.text: HUD loop counter: 0 = endless, otherwise number of rounds before stopping. The buttons left of the lists pick the best loading or selling point automatically.

text.name: fp_help_load_1_text
text.text: The vehicle loads at the point of the 2nd list (fill type of the 3rd list), then drives to the point of the 1st list and stops. Handy to fill a seeder or sprayer before going to the field.

text.name: fp_help_unloader_1_text
text.text: The vehicle waits near the field (1st list), comes under the pipe when the combine or forage harvester calls, follows the machine while unloading, then delivers to the point of the 2nd list and comes back.

text.name: fp_help_unloader_2_text
text.text: Ctrl + Alt + Numpad 0 > Combine unloading: fill level before leaving, side, distances and several trailers per machine.

text.name: fp_help_editor_1_text
text.text: HUD editor button: record a route while driving, connect points, create, rename or delete a destination.

text.name: fp_help_editor_2_text
text.text: Ctrl + Alt + Numpad 1: routes manager (export or import the road network). Ctrl + Shift + F: create field points.
